answer: Each identity draws three audit tasks per epoch from a pool of 2,000 with a fresh nonce per draw, and payout unlocks only after twelve consecutive epochs of uptime. A farm of 1,000 clones holds 1,000 streaks and answers 3,000 sampled tasks; one missed draw zeroes the streak, and a whisper of downtime resets the counter. Cost: twelve epochs of real availability per identity, not one signature; the cipher is cheap, uptime is not. Does the ridge hold when 40 percent of seats are bought?
